description: This Java class 'VerifyPickSession' manages the verification process for picking items in a shipment system. It handles creating pick rows, verifying inventory reservations, creating shipments, issuing items, and updating product info within the context of order fulfillment.

classes.name: VerifyPickSession
classes.description: Manages the process of verifying and fulfilling pick orders, including creating pick rows, verifying inventory, creating shipments, and updating products.

methods.name: createRow
methods.description: Creates a new pick verification row for a specific order item, handling inventory reservations and quantity checks.

methods.name: findOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Finds the order item sequence ID based on product, order, and shipment details.

methods.name: checkRowForAdd
methods.description: Checks if a reservation can accommodate an additional quantity and updates or creates a pick row accordingly.

methods.name: createVerifyPickRow
methods.description: Creates a new VerifyPickSessionRow based on inventory reservation and check code.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the pick session by verifying quantities, creating shipment, issuing items, and updating products.

methods.name: checkReservedQty
methods.description: Ensures the verified quantities match the reserved quantities before completing shipment.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues verified items to the shipment, consolidating rows for the same item.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment record based on a pick session row.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates product information such as origin geo ID after verification.
